reason: I have run my two-person practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years, and I am far too skeptical of new software to pay ₹12,990 upfront when our current system costs nothing. At most I would test the free pilot, but breaking our established routine requires software to be dead simple and completely foolproof.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder, and will managing another tool actually save time when I already check 30 WhatsApp client groups every morning before tea?
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free pilot and seeing firsthand that 1-click Google Drive folder recovery works seamlessly and that the WhatsApp forwarding bridge actually saves time on morning client messages without adding administrative friction.
